_instructions: Paste the contents of the 'mcpServers' object into:
Settings → Copilot → Cloud agent → MCP configuration (in the JSON editor)
Auth model (RFC docs/rfcs/draft-seamless-mcp-auth.md, Track A — AC-A6/A7, LS-5093):
The three hosted MCP servers are reached through their Cognito-fronted API Gateway
endpoints with a short-lived machine-grant bearer. .github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml
mints one token per server scope (mcp/jira, mcp/github, mcp/ci) from the Cognito
client_credentials secret and exports MCP_{JIRA,GITHUB,CI}_BEARER + MCP_{JIRA,GITHUB,CI}_URL;
the headers below send each bearer. The legacy SigV4/OIDC path (AWS_IAM Lambda Function URLs
+ the mcp_invoke IAM policy) was retired in LS-5093 — no AWS credentials or OIDC role are used.
Secrets required in the 'copilot' GitHub environment
(Settings → Environments → copilot → Environment secrets):
MCP_MACHINE_CLIENT_ID      — Cognito client_credentials client id (SSM /<name_prefix>/mcp/cognito/machine-client-id)
MCP_MACHINE_CLIENT_SECRET  — Cognito client_credentials secret (Secrets Manager <env>/mcp-machine-client-secret)
MCP_AUTH_COGNITO_DOMAIN    — Cognito hosted-UI domain, e.g. https://<name_prefix>-mcp.auth.us-east-1.amazoncognito.com
MCP_JIRA_URL    — API Gateway invoke URL, e.g. https://<id>.execute-api.us-east-1.amazonaws.com
MCP_GITHUB_URL  — API Gateway invoke URL
MCP_CI_URL      — API Gateway invoke URL
AGENT_AUTHOR_APP_PRIVATE_KEY — PEM for the Agent Author GitHub App (id 3158619)
The following are NOT needed as secrets here — set automatically by copilot-setup-steps.yml:
GH_TOKEN / GITHUB_TOKEN — generated from the Agent Author GitHub App
DATABASE_URL + DB_* + USE_LOCAL_CREDENTIALS — local Docker Postgres for the db MCP server
MCP_{JIRA,GITHUB,CI}_BEARER — minted per task from MCP_MACHINE_CLIENT_SECRET
Jira / GitHub credentials are NOT needed as environment secrets — they are stored in AWS
Secrets Manager on the hosted Lambdas and injected server-side at invocation time.
Servers NOT included by default (require additional setup to enable in Copilot cloud):
legacy-sports-aws    — requires interactive AWS SSO login (unavailable in cloud)
legacy-sports-browser — not included by default; to enable: add 'npx playwright install chromium'
to copilot-setup-steps.yml, then add the server entry to this config
This file is the canonical source committed to the repo. Do NOT duplicate the mcpServers
JSON into other committed files or embed secrets here — secrets are configured separately
via GitHub Settings → Environments → copilot → Environment secrets.
